# Lawplain

> Singapore legal research: public judgments, legislation and parliamentary records, with links to official sources.

Lawplain is a searchable mirror of public legal materials. Judgment text is source material, not an AI summary or legal advice. Preserve case citations and paragraph references when quoting; consult the linked official source for the current or authoritative text. Collection coverage is a snapshot, not a claim to include every Singapore decision.

Rulings have Markdown at `/judgment/{URL-encoded-citation}/index.md` and a per-ruling `/llms.txt` entry point. Long rulings are split into explicitly labelled text ranges with continuation links; follow all segments before describing a ruling as fully read. Account data, saved notes and private Ask conversations are not part of this public corpus.

## Rulings

- [Judgment directory](https://lawplain.com/judgment/llms.txt): Index of all mirrored ruling identifiers, divided into small Markdown lists linking directly to ruling text.
- [Browse judgments](https://lawplain.com/research/judgments): Human-readable collection and example decisions.

## Other public collections

- [Statutes](https://lawplain.com/research/statutes): Singapore Acts.
- [Subsidiary legislation](https://lawplain.com/research/subsidiary): Regulations and subsidiary instruments.
- [Parliament](https://lawplain.com/research/hansard): Parliamentary speeches.
- [Bills](https://lawplain.com/research/bills): Proposed legislation.
- [Practice directions](https://lawplain.com/research/practice): Court practice materials.
- [Agency guidance](https://lawplain.com/research/guidance): Official agency materials.

## Optional

- [Lawplain blog](https://lawplain.com/blog): Engineering notes on Singapore legal research and the product.
- [How Lawplain works](https://lawplain.com/blog/how-lawplain-researches-singapore-law/llms.txt): Technical article about Graff, source retrieval and the sglaw experiments, with text descriptions of the diagrams.
- [MCP agent guide](https://lawplain.com/developers/mcp/llms.txt): Public setup instructions, authentication, read-only tools, client configurations and research workflow. Tool calls require approved MCP access and a personal API key.
- [MCP documentation](https://lawplain.com/developers/mcp): Human-readable guide with copyable configuration examples.
- [Public API documentation](https://lawplain.com/developers): Search and retrieve legal materials programmatically.
- [Corpus sitemap](https://lawplain.com/corpus-sitemap.xml): Complete public document URL discovery.
